pines.title: Hollow Pines live in Leeds
pines.description: Hollow Pines play a full headline set at the Brudenell Social Club, Leeds, with support from Ana Silva. Doors open at 7 pm.

kaye.title: Mira Kaye in Manchester
kaye.description: Mira Kaye plays a full live headline set with her band at the Albert Hall, Manchester.

harbour.title: Quiet Harbour in Sheffield
harbour.description: Quiet Harbour play an acoustic set at the Leadmill, Sheffield. One night only.

changes.pines: Hollow Pines' drummer is ill, so a stand-in drummer will play the set with the band, and doors now open at 7.30 pm instead of 7 pm.
changes.kaye: Mira Kaye has cancelled her tour. The night at the Albert Hall goes ahead as a DJ set by her producer.
changes.harbour: The show moves from the Leadmill to the Foundry, Sheffield, on the same night.
